import json, os, sys, time, hashlib, platform, resource, subprocess, datetime, tempfile
t0 = time.monotonic()
ROOT = '/home/ryan/rule30-lab'
def H(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(open(os.path.join(ROOT, p), 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
def gen_t(x): return x ^ ((x << 1) | (x << 2))
def gen_t_bw(x):
    w = x.bit_length() + 2; o = 0
    for j in range(w):
        xj = (x >> j) & 1; a = (x >> (j-1)) & 1 if j >= 1 else 0; b = (x >> (j-2)) & 1 if j >= 2 else 0
        if xj ^ (a | b): o |= 1 << j
    return o
def gen_u(x): return gen_t(x) ^ 1
def gen_p(x): return gen_t(x) ^ 1 ^ (0 if x & 1 else 2)
def play(word, T):
    assert word[0] == 'u'; s = 1
    for ch in word[1:]:
        old = s; t = T(old)
        if ch == 't': s = t
        elif ch == 'u': s = t ^ 1
        else: s = t ^ 1 ^ (0 if old & 1 else 2)
    return s
def sched(state, cap=64):
    w = []
    for _ in range(cap):
        r = state & 15
        if r == 7: b = 'u'
        elif r == 11: b = 't'
        else: return ''.join(w)
        state = (gen_u if b == 'u' else gen_t)(gen_p((state - 3) >> 2))
        w.append(b)
    raise AssertionError('cap')
def adm(w): return not any(f in w for f in ('uu', 'ttttt', 'ututtu'))
for x in range(1, 5000): assert gen_t(x) == gen_t_bw(x)
w1 = 'uuputpuuuututututut'; w2 = 'uutuuttuupupuuupup'
z1a = play(w1, gen_t); z1b = play(w1, gen_t_bw)
x2a = play(w2, gen_t); x2b = play(w2, gen_t_bw)
assert (z1a, z1b) == (0x190b934bc7, 0x190b934bc7)
assert (x2a, x2b) == (0x6473d46ab, 0x6473d46ab)
x1 = z1a >> 2; assert x1 == 0x642e4d2f1 and z1a == 4*x1+3
s1 = sched(z1a); s2 = sched(x2a)
assert (s1, s2) == ('uttutututu', 'ttttutututu')
assert s1[3:9] == 'ututut' and s2[4:10] == 'ututut'
assert adm(s1[:3]+'utututu') and adm(s2[:4]+'utututu')
vm = (262,0,200,27,117); vp = (3,0,5,0,7)
assert (vm[4]-vm[2], vp[4]-vp[2]) == (-83, 2)
combo = [2*a+83*b for a,b in zip(vm,vp)]
assert combo == [773,0,815,54,815] and combo[4]-combo[2] == 0 and any(combo)
cpu = 'unknown'
for ln in open('/proc/cpuinfo').read().splitlines():
    if ln.startswith('model name'): cpu = ln.split(':',1)[1].strip(); break
rec = {
 'experiment_id': '20260905_boundary_convex_ancestry_replay',
 'timestamp_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'git_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
 'question': 'problem1',
 'hypothesis': 'The two named convex-obstruction witnesses replay to the recorded states, schedules, windows, admissibility words, strip relation, and vector arithmetic under an independently written stepper.',
 'backend': 'python-exact-integers-packed-and-bitwise',
 'parameters': {'generator_cases': 4999, 'named_witnesses': 2, 'schedule_cap': 64, 'wall_limit_seconds': 60},
 'hardware': {'cpu_model': cpu, 'machine': platform.machine(), 'cpu_count': os.cpu_count(), 'peak_rss_kib': resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss},
 'software': {'python': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform()},
 'runtime_seconds': time.monotonic()-t0,
 'result_hashes': {'scripts/check_signed_slice_convex_obstruction.py': H('scripts/check_signed_slice_convex_obstruction.py'), 'scripts/check_three_return_signed_mass_independent.py': H('scripts/check_three_return_signed_mass_independent.py'), 'src/python/rule30_research_reference.py': H('src/python/rule30_research_reference.py')},
 'result_summary': {'word1_replay_hex': hex(z1a), 'word2_replay_hex': hex(x2a), 'x1_hex': hex(x1), 'strip_suffix': 3, 'schedules': [s1,s2], 'observed_prefix_lengths': [9,10], 'transition_digits': [1,3], 'windows_ok': True, 'admissibility_ok': True, 'ell_values': [-83,2], 'positive_combination': combo},
 'interpretation': 'All tiny checks passed: witness replay, schedules, and arithmetic corroborate the lead ancestry record.',
 'status': 'finite-exhaustive',
 'proof_scope': 'Two named exact witness replays under two independent steppers plus 4999 generator agreement cases; belief enumerations reviewed by code reading, not recomputed.',
 'limitations': ['No independent belief-mass recomputation.', 'No frontier census of any kind.', 'No all-depth claim.']}
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir='/tmp', prefix='boundary_sidecar_', suffix='.tmp')
with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f: json.dump(rec, f, sort_keys=True, indent=2); f.write(chr(10)); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, '/tmp/boundary_sidecar_replay.json')
